in_sanskrit.name: Jisan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Gracious Gift
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jisan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘Ji’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘San’ meaning ‘Grace’ or ‘Gift’. This name is bestowed upon a child as a symbol of the divine blessing and grace bestowed upon him by the gods.

in_hindi.name: जिसन
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is like light or has the qualities of light. The suffix 'an' means 'one who'.

in_marathi.name: Jisan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Gracious Gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jisan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘Ji’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘San’ meaning ‘Grace’ or ‘Gift’. This name is bestowed upon a child as a symbol of the divine blessing and grace bestowed upon him by the gods.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Gracious Gift
